changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Remove duplicate EMR API mappings introduced by CIEL/OCL import. Bahmni/EMR API expects these mappings to resolve to one active concept.
changeSet.sql: DELETE crm FROM concept_reference_map crm JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = crm.concept_id JOIN concept_reference_term crt ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id JOIN concept_reference_source crs ON crs.concept_source_id = crt.concept_source_id WHERE crs.name = 'org.openmrs.module.emrapi' AND c.uuid IN ( '9ceedfb7-60e4-42ce-a11e-f2dbabc82112', 'ce085d74-323c-4c9a-9fdf-051de81dd020' ) AND crt.code IN ( 'Disposition Concept Set', 'Disposition' );
